en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a river valley with vineyards on the surrounding hillsides. A prominent hilltop fortress or castle sits on the left, overlooking clustered houses with steep roofs below. Farmland and a winding river extend into the distance. The upper right corner bears the printed caption "Freyburg a. U." in a decorative typeface, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
